ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 85% low-intensity (black) surface area and 15% high-intensity (white) markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs at the terminal tips of both lobes. High-contrast white linear and circular clusters are distributed sporadically across the central and upper regions of the predominantly black ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 35-40 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge, with notably sharper, more pronounced peaks on the outer lateral portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the distal margins tapering to sharp, pointed wingtips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel rings (white-on-black) clustered in the upper-mid section of the right lobe and scattered across the left lobe, consistent with barnacle scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) across both lobes, with a high concentration of parallel markings on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white scarring at the left wingtip and dense rake marks across the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography with significant pixel-depth variation in serration.
